Features for Patients/Users • Signup/Registration or Login- Allow easy and quick registration or signup through email, mobile number, or OTP. Similarly, ensure password protects logins to keep their information confidential. • Search for Doctors– Provide the option to search for doctors based on the problem, ratings, areas, hospitals, and many more. To make their search process easier, add various filters in the app. • Appointment Booking– Give options for all the available slots to patients and allow them to book the slot in just one tab. System should issue a token number to each booking/patients. • Token Status : App should display who/which token number is serving currently, before 5 tokens patient should get alert and get ready for his turn. • Consultation- Include the option to avail of a paid and free consultation with the doctor. • Online Chat– Build in-app chat features to allow users to chat with doctors privately in case of confusion, misinterpretation of prescriptions, or any other discussion. • Check Doctors details– Allow patients to check doctor’s details like qualifications, consultation fees, feedback and reviews as it will help gain trust towards that doctor. • Document Upload– Allow patients to submit their health data such as test reports, X-rays, etc. • Access to blogs and information- Add a blog section where users can read exclusive blogs or information shared by doctors on health-related topics. • Payment options– Provide the option to pay for a consultation right through the app. Try to add multiple payment options to give more flexibility to users. Features for Doctors/Clinics • Signup/Registration or Login- Ensure doctors or clinics get registered with mobile numbers and email. It is advisable to add password-protected login. • Profile Setting- Allow doctors to create their profiles and add professional and personal information such as name, location, qualifications, year of experience, etc. • Online Consultation– Allow doctors to consult with the patients through video conferencing, chat applications, on-call, file share, document upload, etc. • Patient History– Patient history helps doctors recall the past prescription and give treatment accordingly if the patient or user consults again for the same problem. • Online Follow-ups– For the monthly follow-ups, allow doctors to set in-app appointment reminders. It helps to track the patients coming up or monetize repeat interactions. • Push Notification– Doctors can use push notifications for appointment reminders, cancellations, and confirmation instead of calling each patient manually. This feature updates the patients about any health packages or ongoing special offers.
• FAQs– Add the option where doctors can answer patients’ questions free of cost. It will help to gain patients’ trust and increase the list of their patients. • Information or Health Tips– Provide an option where doctors can share their informative articles or blog on their area of expertise. item.title: Amazon-Style Multi-Seller Platform Build
item.description:
750-1500 USD | # Eagle Vision Edge – Amazon-Style Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Platform
I am developing Eagle Vision Edge, a custom, multi-tenant e-commerce platform that provides an Amazon-style shopping experience while integrating with multiple suppliers through Spark Shipping API v1.
The platform will allow customers to browse and purchase physical products. Suppliers such as Keystone Automotive will handle product fulfillment and shipping, while Eagle Vision Edge manages the storefront, checkout, supplier selection, order processing, customer communication, and tracking.
We already have an existing application and approved prototype. The selected developer will complete the platform according to our Software Development, Confidentiality, Intellectual Property & Security Agreement (Version 4).
**Project Budget:** $1,600 USD (Fixed Price) **Timeline:** 30 Calendar Days **Client:** Eagle Vision Edge LLC
## 1. Customer Shopping Experience
- Amazon-style homepage and responsive storefront. - Advanced product search, filters, categories, and sorting. - Detailed product pages with images, specifications, pricing, and availability. - Customer registration, login, and account management. - Wishlists and saved products. - Shopping cart and secure Stripe checkout. - Supported card and digital-wallet payments through Stripe. - Customer order history and order-status dashboard. - Product reviews and ratings. - Promotional pricing and discount functionality. - Inventory and price revalidation before order submission.
## 2. Supplier and Product Integration
- Spark Shipping API v1 integration. - Initial supplier integration with Keystone Automotive. - Automated product catalog synchronization. - Product inventory and pricing updates. - Lowest-cost eligible supplier selection with administrative override. - Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) compliance. - Configurable supplier integrations. - Automated order submission to supported suppliers. - Split-shipment support when multiple suppliers fulfill an order.
### Missing Product Image Handling
Some Spark Shipping products may not include images.
The developer must implement a process to match these products with images and descriptions maintained by Eagle Vision Edge LLC.
Matching should use reliable product identifiers, including SKU, manufacturer part number, brand, and product attributes. Administrators must be able to review uncertain matches.
## 3. ZIP Code-Based Shipping Calculation
The platform must calculate shipping costs based on:
- Customer destination ZIP code. - Supplier or warehouse origin ZIP code. - Product weight and dimensions. - Shipping method and available carrier rates. - Multiple suppliers and split shipments.
Customers must see the calculated shipping cost before completing payment.
The system must recalculate shipping charges when delivery details change.
If live carrier rates are unavailable, an approved configurable rate table must be supported.
## 4. Order Tracking and Google Maps
Customers must be able to track orders from purchase through delivery.
Required functionality includes:
- Order confirmation and processing status. - Supplier shipment status and tracking number. - Carrier tracking integration. - Google Maps API visualization when shipment-location data is available. - Estimated delivery information where supported. - Tracking of multiple shipments for one order. - Email and SMS shipment notifications.
Google Maps must not be represented as a source of live carrier GPS data unless the carrier provides that information.
## 5. Multi-Tenant Architecture
The platform must support multiple independent storefronts.
Requirements include:
- Tenant-specific storefront configuration. - Tenant data isolation. - Tenant-specific product catalogs and settings. - Administrative controls for tenant management. - Secure authentication and role-based access. - Audit logs and activity tracking.
## 6. Administrative Dashboard
Provide administrative functionality for:
- Product and catalog management. - Supplier integration configuration. - Inventory and pricing management. - Order management and fulfillment monitoring. - Customer management. - Shipment tracking. - Promotions and discounts. - User permissions and audit logs. - Reporting and operational analytics.
## 7. Mandatory Technology Stack
The developer must use:
- **Frontend:** React, Vite, Tailwind CSS. - **Backend:** Java Spring Boot. - **Database:** PostgreSQL or MySQL. - **Payments:** Stripe. - **Supplier Integration:** Spark Shipping API v1. - **Maps:** Google Maps API. - **Source Control:** Private Git repository controlled by Eagle Vision Edge LLC.
Technology substitutions require prior written approval.
## 8. Independent Development and UAT Environment
Spark Shipping does not provide a general-purpose sandbox for this project.
The developer must establish a separate development and UAT environment that includes:
- Mock Spark Shipping API services. - Simulated product catalogs and inventory. - Test pricing and supplier selection. - Simulated order submission and shipment tracking. - Stripe test-mode payments. - Test scenarios for missing product images. - ZIP-code shipping calculation tests. - Multi-tenant security and data-isolation testing. - End-to-end checkout and order lifecycle tests.
Testing must not accidentally create real supplier orders or production charges.
## 9. Milestones and Payments
**Phase 1 — $250: Technical Review and Setup**
Review existing code, architecture, integration requirements, and development environment.
**Phase 2 — $400: Catalog and Storefront Integration**
Complete agreed storefront functionality, supplier catalog integration, product synchronization, and image-matching workflows.
**Phase 3 — $450: Checkout and Order Workflow**
Complete Stripe checkout, shipping cost calculation, order processing, supplier fulfillment integration, and tracking workflows.
**Phase 4 — $500: Full Testing, UAT, and Handover**
Complete system testing, defect correction, UAT, source code delivery, documentation, and deployment handover.
**Total Fixed Budget: $1,600 USD**
Milestone funds may be secured through Freelancer.com, but payment will be released only after the corresponding work is completed, tested, delivered, and accepted in writing.
## 10. Ownership and Final Acceptance
All development must take place in an Eagle Vision Edge LLC-controlled private repository.
Existing client intellectual property remains protected. Project-specific deliverables must be transferred in accordance with the signed agreement.
The final product must materially match the approved prototype and satisfy all agreed functional requirements.
The project must be completed within 30 calendar days of the mutually agreed commencement date. Any extension requires written approval.
The signed Eagle Vision Edge Development Agreement and its approved exhibits govern the project.
This project is intended for our previously selected developer, Delaine Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

item.title: Optimize Wix Art Portfolio
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | I already host my artwork on a Wix site, but right now it feels more like a storage room than a gallery. I need someone who knows Wix inside-out to turn this into a clean, engaging portfolio that keeps visitors browsing—and ideally clicking on well-placed ads so the site can begin generating revenue.
Here’s what I’m after: • Re-structure the galleries so each section is organised by art style or medium. Only my paintings and drawings will be shown; no other categories are needed. • Improve navigation and page flow so viewers are naturally encouraged to keep moving from piece to piece. • Identify and add tasteful ad spots (Google AdSense or a comparable network) that won’t detract from the artwork but will still earn clicks. • Tidy up image metadata, page titles and on-page SEO so the portfolio stands a better chance of being discovered in search. • Make sure everything looks right on mobile as well as desktop.
I’ll provide full access to the existing Wix project along with all original image files. The finished site should be live on my domain, fully responsive, and ready to start serving ads without compromising the look and feel of the art. If you’ve done similar Wix gallery or portfolio work before, I’d love to see it.

item.title: Publish Case Facts Online
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My name and professional standing were questioned in a recent dispute, yet every formal finding shows the accusers were untruthful. I now need a concise, fully verifiable account of the case published on a public website or blog so anyone searching the matter can quickly see the documented facts—nothing more, nothing less.
Scope of work • Distill all available records (court rulings, transcripts, exhibits) into a neutral, fact-only narrative that avoids any potentially defamatory wording. • Build a clean, fast-loading web page or small blog—WordPress, static HTML, or another straightforward platform is fine—where that narrative, supporting documents, and source citations can live. Basic SEO (clear URL, title tag, meta description) is expected so the page can be found when my name or the case is Googled. • Provide guidance on future updates should new material surface.
Quality bar • Every sentence must be traceable to a public document I can supply. • Tone stays factual and restrained; no rhetoric or commentary. • Design remains minimal yet professional, readable on mobile and desktop.
When you reply, include a detailed project proposal: outline your workflow for verifying statements, structuring the content, choosing the web platform, and delivering the finished page ready to publish.

item.title: Build Complete eCommerce Store
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | I want to launch an online store that sells physical products which will be shipped to customers. At first the catalogue will hold no more than 20 items, yet I need every core storefront function in place from day one.
The project covers: • Clean, responsive product pages and a smooth shopping-cart experience. • Secure online payments (Stripe, PayPal, credit-card) with automated order-confirmation emails. • Real-time shipping rates, label generation and customer order-tracking updates.
Please set the store up on the platform you feel is most reliable—Shopify, WooCommerce or another SaaS solution—so long as it allows me to add new products easily, manage inventory, and view sales reports without touching code.
Before hand-off I’ll need a quick walkthrough or short guide that shows how to: – add or edit products, – process and fulfil an order, – issue refunds if necessary.
The store is considered complete once a test order flows from checkout through payment, confirmation email and generated tracking number without errors.

item.title: Clone Peptide Shop Website
item.description:
15-25 AUD/hr | I need an e-commerce site that mirrors every page and feature of https://australianpeptidelabs.com.au/ while swapping the blue palette for a fresh green and re-branding all instances to “Australian Peptide Co.” From the public storefront through to the customer account area, blog, shipping calculator and discount code functions, everything visible (and under the hood) on the reference site should be replicated.
I’ll supply the full catalogue—product names, descriptions, images and pricing—so you can focus on design, build and configuration. Customers must be able to complete their purchase with standard credit or debit cards, so please connect a reliable card gateway (Stripe or a comparable option you recommend).
Deliverables • Pixel-level match to the reference layout, typography and user flow, recoloured in green and updated branding • Responsive design that performs smoothly on desktop, tablet and mobile • Secure card-payment checkout fully tested end-to-end • All pages, menus and functional elements from the source site recreated and online with my provided content loaded • Final deployment on my hosting plus a short admin walk-through so I can manage products and orders myself
If you normally work in WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify, or another modern e-commerce stack, let me know which you prefer and why; I’m open as long as it delivers the identical experience and easy self-management afterward.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
